text:
Maria AE: Quick heads-up — Enterprise 'Northstar' is requesting a 3-month Private POC with a 50% off POC rate, and they want a 12-month committed contract if the POC converts. Asking for deal-desk routing and any blockers.
Sam SE: FYI they also need the full security questionnaire answered and on-prem deployment notes. POC will use a dedicated VPC and customer-managed KMS.
Rachel DealDesk: Please add the opp link and CPQ quote. For special pricing: >25% discount triggers Deal Desk review, >40% needs VP RevOps + Legal. 50% is off-path — will need CRO approval and documented business justification.
Maria AE: opp > https://salesforce.example.com/00Q5g00000ABCdE
Sam SE: attaching quick note on infra constraints: 
```
POC: Private VPC, single-node GPU, token cap = 5M tokens for POC
Commit: 12 months, 4 dedicated GPUs equivalent
Security: KMS-managed keys, audit logs required
```
Rachel DealDesk: CPQ fields to populate (copy into Quote):
```
SBQQ__Opportunity__c: 0065g00000XXXXX
SBQQ__SpecialPrice__c: 40  # start here if you want faster approvals
Custom_Commit_Term__c: 12
POC_Discount__c: 50
Approval_Required__c: true
Approval_Route__c: DealDesk_RevOps_VP_CRO
Deal_Template__c: POC-Private-Discount-v2
```
Tom RevOps: Routing notes — use approval process `DealDesk_Approval_v3`. SLA: Deal Desk initial review within 48h, Legal review within 72h. If CRO required add extra 48h. DealBot will post when you submit quote for approval.
Maria AE: can we reduce POC discount to 40% and add token cap to avoid CRO?
Rachel DealDesk: 40% + 5M token cap + explicit ROI justification should keep it within VP RevOps signoff. If AE can commit to the token cap, we can avoid CRO path.
Jen Security: For Private POC we need the security questionnaire completed before infra is provisioned. Submit via security portal: https://sec-portal.internal/redwood/questionnaires. Key checks: SOC2 status, KMS integration, data residency, retention (default 30 days), access controls.
Sam SE: I can upload the questionnaire. Do we need a signed DPA before POC?
Rachel DealDesk: For Private deployments, yes — DPA + SOW addendum for POC term. Legal template: `DPA-POC-Addendum-v1`. Legal review is fast if standard clauses untouched.
Maria AE: Action list: 1) I will lower discount to 40% and add 5M token cap in CPQ. 2) Sam will upload security questionnaire. 3) I will attach ROI note and submit for DealDesk_Approval_v3.
Tom RevOps: Once submitted, route request to: Rachel DealDesk -> VP RevOps (Marta) -> Legal. Expect 48-96h depending on CRO.
Rachel DealDesk: If you need an expedited path, ping me and include a 1-par pager explaining strategic reasons (e.g., logo, reference, market access). That can shave review time.
DealBot: :white_check_mark: Approval request posted to #deal-approvals for quote 50002. Current route: DealDesk_Approval_v3.
Maria AE: Thanks — submitting now. Will update thread when submitted.
Sam SE: Uploading questionnaire now.
Rachel DealDesk: Noted. I will take the review once it's in.
Maria AE: closing loop — submitted at 1748412899, included token cap and ROI doc.
Rachel DealDesk: Received. I'll pick this up and aim to get back within SLA.
